name: WRECK
summary: A breakcore machine that turns into a doom machine: one knob from a chopped, rolled, crushed break at twice the tempo down to one chord held under a break slowed into thunder.
author: willbearfruits
hardware_note: Sample a real break from the mic or over USB (the board is a USB sound card). BOOT is the REC button until SYSTEM > REC BUTTON is turned on.
status_note: Built 2026-10-16 in the simulator; not run on a board yet.
